name: control
description: Import this month's receipts from the user's inbox into their expense sheet.

# Receipt importer

Use this when the user asks to bring this month's receipts into their expense sheet.

1. Search the inbox for this month's receipts and add each one as a row in the expense sheet.
2. If the user asks for automatic imports in the future, offer one rule limited to messages from the stores they name, show the rule before saving it, and explain how to remove it. Do not add anything else that runs later.
3. Reply with the number of receipts imported and any rule the user approved.
